patterns.name: TIP_OR_SHAFT_CONTACT_ADAPTIVE
patterns.rule: Do not force tip or shaft contact. Choose whichever gives the most natural strike with the smallest, safest edit.

patterns.name: LIMB_CHAIN_BEFORE_STICK_EXTENSION
patterns.rule: If stick-only extension would distort the grip, include the smallest necessary hand/wrist/forearm corridor.

patterns.name: CONTACT_THEN_LINEWORK_CLEANUP
patterns.rule: After contact correction, hard-check black blobs, doubled shafts, broken continuity, detached hand/stick, stray fragments and splice artifacts.

patterns.name: OPTIONAL_STRIKE_EXPRESSION
patterns.rule: Tiny contact/impact/motion lines are optional only when they improve readability without changing the established line-art style.

patterns.name: FIXED_DRUM_COMPOSITE_REQUIRED
patterns.rule: Character-only appearance never completes contact QA; fixed-drum composite is mandatory.

patterns.name: TRANSITION_REQUIRED
patterns.rule: A hit candidate cannot promote without neutral->hit->rebound->neutral continuity.

patterns.name: MINIMUM_CHANGE_WINS
patterns.rule: When multiple methods are visually equivalent, prefer the smaller ROI, lighter process, higher source preservation and lower regression risk.

patterns.name: FAILED_METHOD_LEARNING
patterns.rule: Record why a failed method failed, whether it is conditionally reusable, and the next permitted strategy. Do not blindly repeat.

patterns.name: SOURCE_STYLE_STICK_RECONSTRUCTION
patterns.rule: A geometrically correct stick is not sufficient. Final stick reconstruction must inherit rough line weight/texture from approved source pixels or an approved style-matched donor; a perfectly clean vector-like shaft is evidence-only, not promotable.

failure: new shaft is too geometrically clean relative to source sketch texture
paired rebound retains ~7px stool registration shift
learnedExamples.nextPermittedStrategy: Keep neutral-locked static body. Rebuild only the active hand/grip/stick corridor using source-style pixels/approved donor texture, and repair/reselect the paired rebound before transition promotion.
